pages.text: Besides chopping, it breaks the opponent's shield now and then, like the vanilla axe. It also carries permanent Efficiency and Fortune.

The $(b)Mushashite$() one is forged from scratch with its ingot, sticks and the Heart Of The Fallen.$(br2)The $(b)Joanfoite$() and $(b)Nadienite$() ones are upgraded from the previous tier, placing it in the center.
